question: What is the nature and position of the suṣumnā channel?
premises: Suṣumnā is located in the middle.
It has the form of Brahman.
This is addressed to the supreme goddess.
inference: The central suṣumnā channel is identified with the nature of Brahman.
uncertainties: tanmadhye presupposes reference to other channels from context.
plain_english: O supreme goddess, in the middle of them is suṣumnā, which has the form of Brahman.
